status: proposal: altitude 3 of the email policy. Names are roles; keys are bound in team/keys or the vault, never here.

gateway.about: Holds the Google token. Syncs in, sends approved actions, writes the outbox.

firewall.about: Reads raw messages and writes the cleaned copy. Proposes nothing.

triage.about: Reads cleaned copies, proposes labels and archiving.

drafter.about: Reads cleaned copies, proposes replies and new emails.

crm.about: Reads cleaned copies and links them to people in the CRM. Proposes labels only.

approver.about: A person. Approves or rejects actions, and owns the kill switch.
